text:
kevin: Heads-up — after yesterday's routing change I'm seeing SLO alerts double for a small subset of tenants. Console shows the same threshold firing in both primary and fallback tiers. anyone else see this? :eyes:

maya: I noticed the spike too. Looks like when primary route is overloaded the fallback path still re-evaluates the alert and doesn't dedupe across routes.

elena: yep. notify-service treats each route as an independent policy evaluation. fallback gets its own notify job so two notifications get enqueued.

tom: quick question — is this only for tenant-level thresholds or also per-route SLOs?

maya: mostly tenant-level, but some per-route SLOs that inherit tenant thresholds seem affected (inheritance causes multiple active policies).

kevin: reproducer: set tenant A primary->region1 (max qps) and fallback->region2, then throttle region1 for 10s. you get primary alert, then fallback triggers when it sees same symptom.

elena: proposed short-term fix: introduce cross-route dedupe key for notify enqueue. key = `${tenant}:${slo_id}:${window_start}` so fallback can check if an active notification exists.

sam: UX question — if we dedupe, do we still surface that a fallback was used in the console? product wants visibility when fallback engaged.

elena: yes — we can emit an annotation on the existing alert instance: `fallback_used: region2`. frontend can show sidecar info rather than a separate alert.

tom: what about quotas? If fallback spawns extra notify jobs, it also burns notify quota and pushes through rate-limiter. dedupe helps cost but need to ensure quota accounting remains accurate.

maya: agreed. recommend: 1) dedupe on enqueue, 2) record per-route telemetry (counts) even when deduped so billing/telemetry reflect attempts, 3) show a collapsed timeline in console.

kevin: can someone draft a small patch for notify-service? elena?

elena: will open PR. quick sketch of enqueue pseudocode:

```
// before: enqueue(alertInstance) -> job created per-route
// after: key = `${tenant}:${slo}:${window}`
if (!dedupeStore.claim(key)) {
  enqueue(job)
} else {
  annotateExisting(key, {fallback: route})
  telemetry.increment('notify.deduped')
  billing.record_attempt(route, 'deduped')
}
```

sam: timeline and UX: can we show a tiny badge on the alert row like `Fallback→region2` and a collapsed count `+1 deduped`? that should satisfy product visibility and avoid clutter.

kevin: perfect. also we should ensure the console threshold preview sim correctly shows this behavior during rollout (so users understand fallback won't double-alert).

tom: for rollout: add integration test that simulates route overload and asserts only one visible alert, but telemetry shows both attempts.

sre-bot: INCIDENT-2026 created: duplicate-slo-notify-spike. assigned to elena. link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026

maya: tagging @oncall for visibility — could hit a larger tenant during peak tomorrow.

elena: PR opened: r/platform/notify#482. includes dedupe store (redis TTL 2x window) and annotation API. will request reviews from tom and kevin.

kevin: thanks. next steps: elena lands PR, tom adds integration test in router-integration suite, sam designs tiny console badge, and we ship a canary to dedicated tier first. I'll add to rollout checklist.

sam: I'll add a console small UI change to the release notes and a tooltip explaining dedupe semantics.

kevin: awesome. if anyone sees further oddities please @kevin or drop here. closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
